description: Two unrelated closed numerals facts; both rfl/simp-provable, reduce to distinct normal forms (2=2 vs 4=4).
Reflexivity of ≤ on ℕ vs reflexivity of = on ℝ; different types and predicates, both trivially true.
A closed integer product vs 0 ≤ 1 on ℝ; both norm_num/simp-provable, no shared content.
String-length fact vs Boolean-algebra fact; both decide/rfl-provable, disjoint types.
n < n+1 on ℕ vs m-1 < m on ℤ; both closed by omega, different types and inequalities.
Doubling identity on ℕ vs additive cancellation on ℤ; both omega-provable, logically independent.
Remainder bound on ℕ vs sign preservation under successor on ℤ; both omega-provable, unrelated.
a ≤ a+b on ℕ vs the </≤ shift on ℤ; both omega-provable, unrelated statements.
Nat.add_comm vs List.length_append; exact? closes each side from the library, contents unrelated.
Nat.mul_comm vs List.reverse_reverse; two unrelated library facts, each exact?-closable.
add_zero on ℝ vs Set.nonempty_of_mem; algebra vs set theory, both instantly library-provable.
Nat.succ_ne_zero vs List.append_nil; both verbatim library facts, no semantic relation.
n < 0 is unsatisfiable on ℕ so the reference is vacuously true regardless of the Prime conclusion; candidate is unrelated reflexivity.
False → (0 = 1) is vacuously true; candidate is an unrelated multiplicative identity.
Both sides vacuous under contradictory hypotheses (p ∧ ¬p; n+1 ≤ n on ℕ) with absurd unrelated conclusions.
Both about List.reverse on List ℕ, both exact?-closable, but involution vs length-preservation are independent facts.
Nat.gcd_self vs Nat.gcd_zero_right; identical vocabulary and shape, logically independent identities.
Finset.subset_union_left vs Finset.inter_subset_left; same objects s t, dual lattice facts, not equivalent.
Triangle inequality vs nonnegativity of |·| on ℝ; same vocabulary, both abs_* library lemmas, independent.
Two different numeric instances of add_comm; reduce to 5=5 vs 12=12 so not defeq, no semantic relation between the instances.
2^3 = 8 vs 3^2 = 9 on ℤ; both decide/norm_num-provable closed facts, unrelated instances.
10 ∣ 100 vs 7 ∣ 49; different witnesses, both decide-provable, unrelated divisibility instances.
Simon Sorg's generalization from BEq+ A.6.1: candidate p → p is a tautology, so bidirectional implication holds against any true reference.
BEq+ A.6.1 shape: reference is a real Zsqrtd cast-divisibility fact (Zsqrtd.intCast_dvd_intCast); candidate's hypothesis restates its goal, so it is trivially true.

'positive derivative => increasing': Monotone (ref) vs StrictMono (cand). Invalid dir ref->cand closes ante-free via strictMono_of_deriv_pos (Prop-conclusioned, not Eq/Iff). Monotone is strictly weaker. Unguarded exact? prover false-accepts; Eq/Iff shape-filter rejects.

BddAbove range (ref) vs attained max (cand) for continuous fn on compact space. Invalid dir ref->cand closes ante-free via EVT IsCompact.exists_isMaxOn. BddAbove does not yield a maximizer. Eq/Iff shape-filter rejects (conclusion is an exists).

'some power ==1 mod n' (ref) vs Euler a^phi(n)==1 (cand). ModEq UNFOLDS to Eq, so the shape-filter alone is fooled -- the ANTE-GATE rejects (bridge proves cand without the ref hypothesis). Existence of a period does not pin the exponent to phi(n). Guards the ante-gate.

IVT root under ContinuousOn Icc (ref) vs global Continuous (cand). Hypothesis-strengthening drift: cand assumes strictly more, so cand->ref is invalid, but ref's conclusion is provable ante-free from ContinuousOn via intermediate_value_Icc. Unguarded search false-accepts.
